source_note: 判断序列在区间内稠密的几个命题
english_source_note: Criteria for Density of Sequences in an Interval
callout_id: 判断序列在区间内稠密的几个命题#5
statement_en: Let $S_N:=\sum_{n\leq N} a_n$ be a bounded divergent sequence of partial sums, where $a_n\in\mathbb{R}$ and $a_n\to 0$. Then the partial sums $S_N$ are dense in the interval $(\liminf_{N\to\infty} S_N,\limsup_{N\to\infty} S_N)$.
key_techniques: limsup and liminf of partial sums
callout_body: 序列$S_N:=\sum_{n\leq N}a_n$有界并且发散，其中$a_n$是实数，并且$a_n\to 0$。那么其部分和序列$S_N:=\sum_{n\leq N}a_n$会在区间$(\liminf_{N\to \infty}S_N,\limsup_{N\to \infty}S_N)$中稠密。
